home.title: Movement assessments from a phone camera
home.lead: Fit T. Cent Assessments measures how you move from a video recorded on your phone. Pose estimation runs in your browser, and your video stays on your device.
home.firstBody: Record a side-on slow-motion clip of a hurdle clearance. The app finds takeoff and touchdown, then shows timing and body angles you can check frame by frame.
later: Overhead squat assessment (based on NASM's protocol)
Single-leg squat assessment (based on NASM's protocol)
Pushing and pulling assessments (based on NASM's protocol)
home.privacyBody: Video is decoded and analyzed on your phone or laptop. Saved results hold numbers and, if you allow it, body landmarks. Never the video.
notes: Flags are screening suggestions for a coach to confirm. They are not medical advice.
For adults (18 and over) for now.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Sign in with WitUS is not switched on yet. When it is, signing in lets you save results. Running an analysis will not need an account.
